release.content: pubkit 0.21.1 was released on 2026-10-30 from commit 54f757071eed3b664928ddc09554b7e82ed461c2 with these changes.

rows: actions/pr-label says whether the pull request a run is for (the event's own, a merge queue group's, or on a push the ones merged into the pushed commit) carries a label, "refresh cache" by default, and actions/cache's restore takes refresh: 'true' (pubkit cache plan --refresh) to restore no entry, fetched or made, so a pull request labelled refresh cache rebuilds everything once it merges
